description.value: Rosemary Rocksalt is a Vancouver-area bagel chain specializing in authentic Montreal-style bagels that are hand-rolled, honey-boiled, and baked fresh daily in a traditional open-flame stone-hearth oven. The Richmond location on Steveston Highway offers bagel sandwiches, house-made cream cheeses, soups, and take-home grocery items sourced from local suppliers. It sits along the Steveston cycling corridor and markets itself as a community gathering place, making it a welcoming and substantive food stop on a coastal or delta touring route.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 8m; rack at 21m; rack at 68m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Rosemary Rocksalt is a real, actively operating Montreal-style bagel chain with three Lower Mainland locations. The Richmond location at 8050-11688 Steveston Hwy, (604) 274-9800, is consistently listed across the /pages/location, /pages/contact, and /pages/order subpages, matching the OSM coordinates for Richmond. The menu explicitly labels Cashew Cream Cheese as Vegan, Butternut Squash Soup as Vegetarian & Gluten Free, and the catering page notes vegetarian options on request; the order page confirms pickup availability.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone; both were sourced from the website's Richmond location listing rather than OSM tags.
OSM name is 'Rosemary Rocksalt Bagelry' but the brand name used throughout the website is 'Rosemary Rocksalt' without the 'Bagelry' suffix — minor naming discrepancy worth verifying on-site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating bagel café with a confirmed physical Richmond address and fully functional website. A useful and substantive food stop for touring cyclists riding the Steveston or south Richmond cycling routes.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists Cashew Cream Cheese (Vegan) in three flavours, Butternut Squash Soup (Vegetarian & Gluten Free), Broccoli Cheddar Soup (Vegetarian), and a North Shore veggie bagel sandwich. Catering page notes 'Vegetarian options available upon request.'
